summary.text: Don Douglas is a Republican state senator who has represented District 22 since November 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Donald Douglas earned a bachelor's degree in biology from Western Kentucky University.
His career experience includes working as medical director and lead physician of Tony Delk IMAC Regeneration Center.
In the 2025-2026 session he is vice chair of the Senate Transportation Committee and serves on the Banking and Insurance, Health and Welfare, and Licensing and Occupations committees.
